blocks.text: Former UNIS member Gehlee Dangca is returning to the Philippines to pursue opportunities as a solo artist following the conclusion of the K-pop girl group’s official activities. Dangca is set to arrive in the Philippines on Sept. 29, according to Universal Records Philippines, which will continue to serve as her recording label. Her local career will be managed by GLXY Talent Management and Star Horizon TV Production. Her homecoming comes days after UNIS concluded its official group activities on Sept. 26 following the end of its exclusive contract with F&F Entertainment.
